description: NEW JERSEY – Hudson County Executive Craig Guy and State Senator (LD-33)/ Union City Mayor Brian Stack today led Hudson County Mayors in endorsing Congressman Rob Menendez for re-election. “Rob has been a vital partner for Hudson County in Washington and at home,” said County Executive Craig Guy. “From bringing back federal resources for critical infrastructure projects to […]

title: Hudson County Executive Craig Guy, Senator/Mayor Brian Stack, and Hudson County Mayors Endorse Congressman Rob Menendez for Re-Election - Rob Menendez
